info.name: Eva
info.summary: Local RAG assistant over your own files via Ollama
info.description:
Index your own Nextcloud files as a knowledge base and chat about them with a locally running Large Language Model (Ollama). The app reads your files, splits them into chunks, creates embeddings and makes them searchable via RAG. Answers always name the source (file path) the model took the information from.
- Pure PHP, no external RAG service / no external database, no cloud. - Text files (txt, md, code, csv, tsv, html, json, xml, yaml, toml, rtf, sql, ...), PDF, Office (docx/xlsx/pptx incl. macro/template variants), OpenDocument (odt, ods, odp), EPUB and more. - Hybrid retrieval: vector search + lexical search (BM25), RRF fusion. - The chat can optionally perform actions on the Nextcloud (create, rename, search files and templates) across the whole home space, incl. Notes and Contacts. - No configuration required: embedding and chat model come from your local Ollama instance.
info.author: Benedikt Schächner
